source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the emphatic male designation, shepherding and abrupt rescue.
key_decisions.before: She gave birth to a male child, one who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, but her child was caught up to God and to his throne,
key_decisions.after: She gave birth to a son, a male child who is to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod. Her child was snatched away to God and to his throne.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: She gave birth to a male child, one who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, but her child was caught up to God and to his throne,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the two wings and untranslated symbolic time formula rather than substituting a calculated duration.
key_decisions.before: But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she might fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to the place where she is to be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
key_decisions.after: The woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she could fly to her place in the wilderness, where she is fed for a time, times and half a time, away from the serpent's presence.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she might fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to the place where she is to be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
